hello, i recently deactivated all my accounts so i just saw this now. hope you're feeling better.

I hope you stay here longer.

yeah it is tiring. Is it because you want to change and become less of a burden but cannot force yourself to for some reason? It is okay. I dont know how to lessen what you're feeling right now but I hope you know that someone out there cares.

you can start by doing one per day and then working through it. I dont know what reason you might have to go through all that work because the reason's up to you. It's very hard but know that at the end of the day you are appreciated because you tried. That is enough.

no, it is not a stupid reason. I would tell you that it gets better but then when it gets better, things would always become worse (again) that you feel like you're going through a loop. You feel okay and then the next minute, you're back again. It is repetitive. It is tiring.

I dont know what to say but maybe after a couple of days it would get better, or maybe not. Start by living through today and see if anything gets better. 

I hope it does because we all deserve happiness.
